name: CleverTap
description: CleverTap is a customer-engagement platform for analytics, segmentation, lifecycle campaigns, personalization, experimentation, and cross-channel messaging. Product and growth teams use it to understand user behavior and coordinate relevant experiences across mobile and web products.
agentUseSummary: Add customer-owned CleverTap API credentials, select the exact data-center region, and bind one profile identity; agents can then retrieve a redacted summary of only that profile through a fixed read-only endpoint.

credentialRequirements.name: CLEVERTAP_ACCOUNT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: CleverTap Account ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use the Project ID shown in CleverTap Settings. Relay encrypts the value and sends it only in the X-CleverTap-Account-Id header.

credentialRequirements.name: CLEVERTAP_PASSCODE
credentialRequirements.label: CleverTap API passcode
credentialRequirements.helpText: Prefer a dedicated expiring account passcode or an admin-granted user passcode. Relay encrypts it and sends it only in the X-CleverTap-Passcode header.

credentialRequirements.name: CLEVERTAP_REGION
credentialRequirements.label: CleverTap data-center region
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter exactly eu1, in1, sg1, us1, aps3, or mec1. Relay maps the code to the corresponding official API origin.

credentialRequirements.name: CLEVERTAP_PROFILE_IDENTITY
credentialRequirements.label: Bound CleverTap profile identity
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind the connection to one exact CleverTap identity. Agents cannot supply or override profile identifiers at runtime.

capabilities.label: Read one bound user profile
capabilities.description: Retrieve a bounded summary for one connection-bound identity while excluding custom-property values, device tokens, object IDs, and raw provider data.

approvalRequired.label: Get bound CleverTap user profile
approvalRequired.description: Read one exact bound profile and return bounded name/email, event summaries, platform names, and custom-property keys with sensitive device and raw fields removed.

blocked.label: Access other profiles or exports
blocked.description: Arbitrary identities, emails, object IDs, event-based profile exports, cursors, profile counts, bulk profile access, raw records, custom-property values, device tokens, and object IDs remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access events, analytics, or campaigns
blocked.description: Event exports, reports, cohorts, segments, funnels, catalogs, recommendations, journeys, campaigns, messages, subscription groups, and campaign triggers remain blocked.

blocked.label: Write, delete, or administer CleverTap
blocked.description: Profile or event uploads, profile deletion/demerge, device-token changes, campaign sends, wallet changes, settings, users, passcodes, webhooks, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary origins, regions, paths, methods, headers, queries, bodies, identifier overrides, pagination, retries, raw responses, browser sessions, SDK surfaces, undocumented endpoints, and bulk operations remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded profile read requires approval; other identities, raw profile data, exports, analytics, campaigns, writes, deletes, administration, arbitrary API access, and bulk remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded profile read runs directly; exact identity/region binding, fixed endpoint, redaction, response caps, audits, and provider authorization remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one fixed regional CleverTap profile wrapper with exact identity binding and sensitive-field redaction.
Hermes receives the same fixed regional CleverTap profile wrapper with exact identity binding and sensitive-field redaction.

providerSetup.blocker: CleverTap API access requires an eligible customer project, a customer-created account or user passcode, the exact project region, and one existing profile identity.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer admin creates a dedicated expiring passcode, supplies the Project ID, exact region, and one profile identity, then completes a live read-only connection check.

evidence.supports: CleverTap documents Account ID plus Account/User Passcode headers, recommends user passcodes for safer delegation, and supports dedicated account passcodes with expiry and revocation.
CleverTap documents the exact Europe, India, Singapore, United States, Indonesia, and Middle East API origins used by the region allowlist.

CleverTap documents GET /1/profile.json with exactly one email, identity, or objectId lookup and an identity-rich profile response; Relay fixes the call to one bound identity and redacts raw sensitive fields.
CleverTap documents profile reads, uploads, device-token changes, counts, deletion, and demerge as separate surfaces; V1 includes only the bounded read.

securityNotes: Account ID, passcode, region, and profile identity are encrypted as secret references; the passcode is sent only in the documented authentication header to the allowlisted regional origin.
Relay allowlists only GET /1/profile.json with one URL-encoded connection-bound identity, rejects redirects, uses a 60-second timeout, caps responses at 1 MB, and does not accept runtime identifiers.

The result caps event summaries at 25, platform names at 10, custom-property keys at 50, and excludes custom-property values, push tokens, object IDs, raw platform records, cursors, and raw responses.

Other profile lookups/exports, events, analytics, catalogs, recommendations, segments, campaigns, messages, triggers, uploads, deletes, settings, passcodes, administration, arbitrary APIs, pagination, and bulk remain blocked.
Provider 401/403/429 and server errors are surfaced safely; credential creation/capture, provider-console work, and live acceptance remain customer/external steps.
